-- ============================================================
-- TABLE DEFINITIONS
-- Each LOCATION is the table's REAL physical path in Unity
-- Catalog's managed storage, found via:
--   DESCRIBE DETAIL azuresalesdatabricks.gold.<table_name>;
-- NOT the human-readable table name.
-- ============================================================


-- ============================================================
-- DIMENSION TABLES
-- ============================================================

-- dim_date
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dim_date (
    date_key VARCHAR(8),
    full_date DATE,
    day INT,
    month INT,
    month_name VARCHAR(20),
    quarter INT,
    year INT,/Screenshot 2026-07-29 at 19.16.45.png
    day_of_week VARCHAR(20),
    is_weekend BIT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/da579f5d-fc61-42b7-b5c0-1f3d51cf321f/tables/b77df490-ec7a-497e-a054-a528bac022d2/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_lake,
    FILE_FORMAT = delta_format
);

-- dim_category
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dim_category (
    category_id VARCHAR(80),
    category_name VARCHAR(50),
    subcategory_name VARCHAR(50)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/da579f5d-fc61-42b7-b5c0-1f3d51cf321f/tables/75b6eafb-17d1-4158-96a4-15b928b07114/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_lake,
    FILE_FORMAT = delta_format
);

-- dim_customer
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dim_customer (
    customer_key VARCHAR(80),
    customer_id VARCHAR(20),
    first_name VARCHAR(50),
    last_name VARCHAR(50),
    email VARCHAR(100),
    phone VARCHAR(30),
    address VARCHAR(100),
    city VARCHAR(50),
    state VARCHAR(20),
    zip_code VARCHAR(10),
    country VARCHAR(50),
    segment VARCHAR(30),
    effective_start_date DATE,
    effective_end_date DATE,
    is_current BIT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/da579f5d-fc61-42b7-b5c0-1f3d51cf321f/tables/22c9eac0-eed4-42f9-8635-07cba97e5950/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_lake,
    FILE_FORMAT = delta_format
);

-- dim_product
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dim_product (
    product_key VARCHAR(80),
    product_id VARCHAR(20),
    product_name VARCHAR(100),
    category_id VARCHAR(80),
    brand VARCHAR(50),
    unit_cost FLOAT,
    unit_price FLOAT,
    effective_start_date DATE,
    effective_end_date DATE,
    is_current BIT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/da579f5d-fc61-42b7-b5c0-1f3d51cf321f/tables/3577a183-36b1-4984-921a-ec58ac26529d/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_lake,
    FILE_FORMAT = delta_format
);

-- dim_store
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dim_store (
    store_key VARCHAR(80),
    store_id VARCHAR(20),
    store_name VARCHAR(100),
    region VARCHAR(30),
    city VARCHAR(50),
    state VARCHAR(20),
    store_type VARCHAR(30),
    effective_start_date DATE,
    effective_end_date DATE,
    is_current BIT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/da579f5d-fc61-42b7-b5c0-1f3d51cf321f/tables/c3b86605-38b0-4bdf-821e-8a0b38ccbf6d/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_lake,
    FILE_FORMAT = delta_format
);

-- dim_sales_rep
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dim_sales_rep (
    rep_key VARCHAR(80),
    rep_id VARCHAR(20),
    rep_name VARCHAR(100),
    email VARCHAR(100),
    store_key VARCHAR(80),
    region VARCHAR(30),
    effective_start_date DATE,
    effective_end_date DATE,
    is_current BIT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/da579f5d-fc61-42b7-b5c0-1f3d51cf321f/tables/ca62e6fe-2b92-49b6-a30f-fc7e3ae14ac2/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_lake,
    FILE_FORMAT = delta_format
);

-- ============================================================
-- FACT TABLES
-- ============================================================

-- fact_sales
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE fact_sales (
    order_item_id VARCHAR(20),
    order_id VARCHAR(20),
    customer_key VARCHAR(80),
    product_key VARCHAR(80),
    store_key VARCHAR(80),
    rep_key VARCHAR(80),
    date_key VARCHAR(8),
    quantity INT,
    unit_price FLOAT,
    discount_pct INT,
    line_total FLOAT,
    order_status VARCHAR(20)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/da579f5d-fc61-42b7-b5c0-1f3d51cf321f/tables/5f068330-ace8-4982-81f2-c9dafaa599f5/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_lake,
    FILE_FORMAT = delta_format
);

-- fact_returns
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE fact_returns (
    return_id VARCHAR(20),
    order_item_id VARCHAR(20),
    date_key VARCHAR(8),
    return_reason VARCHAR(100),
    refund_amount FLOAT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = '__unitystorage/schemas/da579f5d-fc61-42b7-b5c0-1f3d51cf321f/tables/dd7a4c62-042a-480d-8b1b-0af96239aaa0/',
    DATA_SOURCE = gold_lake,
    FILE_FORMAT = delta_format
);


-- Verification
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM fact_returns;

-- verify at once
SELECT 'dim_date' AS tbl, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM dim_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_category', COUNT(*) FROM dim_category
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_customer', COUNT(*) FROM dim_customer
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_product', COUNT(*) FROM dim_product
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_store', COUNT(*) FROM dim_store
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_sales_rep', COUNT(*) FROM dim_sales_rep
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_sales', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_returns', COUNT(*) FROM fact_returns;
